w: Both readers placed T3-006 and T3-076. 'Digo que pintemos la bandera sobre la de ellos', 'Vamos a trollear a /r/argentina', 'Yo opino que le robemos la bandera a italia', 'Help us turn the US flag into a mexican flag' and 'Let's coordinate an all-out attack at noon' call and report attacks on others' work (T3-006), and lead by count. 'No es buena idea convocar a los usuarios a ir en masa a otro sub', 'El Respeto al derecho ajeno es la Paz', 'Edit: ok no vandalizen ... Mejor hay que crear mas cosas' and 'Es mejor no entrar en guerra con nadie' talk the room out of its attacks (T3-076). The ruling is the readers' list.

Both readers placed T3-006. 'Faction players messing with r/TF2', a creeper face 'on the Swedish Flag' and 'trying to deface the muhrica flag' attack others' work (T3-006). The sword that 'is proceding to impale all pixel characters in its path', 'Merciless Minecraft Sword of Death - First Victim: Bob Ross. Join us', 'invade the blue corner with a golden Sword' and a grass block 'on blue corner' grow the room's own work over neighbours' ground (T3-061, my B1), by the T3-006|T3-061 paragraph. The two tie at five and T3-006 leads on placements; both are kept.

Reading A placed T3-006, T3-061 and T3-068, reader B T3-006 and T3-068. 'kiwi of justice, destroy the weebs!', 'Should we kill the lolicons unite sign', 'cut right through the logo, then we take out those Danes' and 'kill the kiwi' call attacks on others' work (T3-006, all three placements), and lead by count. 'Only seems fair we take your flag', 'backdoor Germany while they're busy with France and put ANZAC there', 'lazers don't stop, it needs to burn it's way to the other side of the map' and 'make NZ TAKE OVER!' grow the room's work into neighbours' ground (T3-061, reader A and my B1). 'HIJACK THE AUSSIE FLAG', turning the UK flag 'into a giant NZ/AU flag' and the Danes replacing the Kiwi 'with Andrea as revenge' turn another's mark into a room's own sign (T3-068, both readers). The call to arms and the Void are defence, which no placement holds.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-068, reader B T3-006. 'They can't own two corners, we need to take it from them' and 'DOWN WITH BLUE CORNER!' call attacks on another room's work (T3-006, all three placements). Turning PCMasterRace into 'NintendoMasterRace' and the OSU logo into Kirby (reader A's T3-068), and r/SonicTheHedgehog's and r/Metroid's requests for help (my B1's T3-084), hold two concepts each with one placement; T3-006 leads the level with three, so neither is kept, and joining the red corner (my B1's T3-150) is not reached. 'DON'T LET THE BLUE CONSUME US!' is defence, which no placement holds.

Both readers placed T3-006, reader A with a bag. 'legg blått i det danske flagget!', 'vi må stå sammen om at destruere svensken!', 'Klokken 09:15 starter invasjonen av Hellas!', 'Kan vi ødelegge denne biten' and 'Freden er over!' call attacks on others' flags (T3-006), and lead by count. The alarms about Danish and Finnish attacks are defence, and 'OUR FLAG WILL BLOT OUT THE SUN' names no neighbour; no placement holds them.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-068, reader B T3-006. The two tie at three and T3-006 leads on placements. 'I think we're better off maintaining' weighs upkeep against the attack, which my B1's T3-124 does not take (no move is weighed).

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-171, reader B T3-006. 'RED CORNER DECLARES WAR ON THE BLUE CORNER', 'THOSE BASTARDS. Defending the pinwheel, the jokes and helping the Rockets build are acts no placement holds; my B1's T3-058 and T3-124 have no concept of their own.

Both readers placed T3-006. 'RIP Detroit. Both readers placed T3-006 and T3-076. 'we need an offensive position. Go for the eyes', 'LETS TURN THOSE LASERS GREEN', 'we create a green counter laser', 'Deface the /r/spacex spot!' and 'We need to expand to intimate r/meat' call counterattacks on others' work (T3-006), and lead by count.
